subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API after the session-targeting and error-boundary blockers are fixed?
rationale: The mechanical blockers are fixable, but the PR creates a new public Gateway surface and optional ContextEngine plugin contract whose long-term API and admin rotate semantics need maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve after blockers
options.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, bounded capability errors, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.

options.title: Narrow the control surface
options.body: Land only read-scoped capabilities/status/doctor first and defer admin rotate until maintainers are ready to own that operator action.

options.title: Defer to plugins
options.body: Pause or close the core PR and keep context-engine maintenance control on plugin/private surfaces until a broader Gateway control contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve after blockers
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, bounded capability errors, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway/session-control history makes steipete the best available owner for deciding whether this new Gateway control surface fits the current operator API direction.
